T:P1.2.text: Visit G-III Apparel Group online to learn about our footprint as a global fashion leader with a portfolio of over 30 licensed and owned brands.

T:P1.3.text: As a global leader in fashion, we unlock the value of our 30+ brands through our team’s agility and innovation.

T:P1.4.text: We are global experts in design, sourcing, distribution and marketing, bringing excitement and confidence to customers through the fashion we create.

T:P1.5.text: Brands Across a Range of Categories

T:P1.6.text: With over 30 owned and licensed global brands in our portfolio, our strengths across the full product life cycle enable us to unlock their value and fuel growth.

T:P1.7.text: Marc Jacobs is an iconic American fashion house known for its fearless designs and playful approach to luxury. Since its inception the brand has created a lasting impact on the fashion industry, becoming synonymous with creativity, individuality, and timeless craftsmanship. Marc Jacobs continues to influence the world of fashion with its innovative vision and bold approach to style.

T:P1.8.text: When Donna Karan launched her first collection she started with a city, Seven Easy Pieces, and the power of a woman—and she revolutionized the way women dress.

T:P1.9.text: the House of Karl Lagerfeld shares the iconic vision and design aesthetic of its namesake, fused with a contemporary, forward-looking spirit.

T:P1.10.text: From the house founded by Donna Karan DKNY emerged.

T:P1.11.text: Vilebrequin cultivates a spirit of refinement and fantasy, staying true to the casual charm the house was founded on in St. Tropez. Vilebrequin joined the G-III portfolio providing the company with a new core competency and a robust global retail network.

T:P1.12.text: G-III’s success comes from our agility, drive and dedication to delivering for our customers. Every member of the team brings a unique point of view that adds something special to our company and the products we create.

T:P2.1.text: Who We Are – G-III Apparel Group, Ltd.

T:P2.2.text: G-III excels at bringing excitement and confidence to customers through the fashion we create. We are global experts in design, sourcing, distribution and marketing, which enables us to fuel the growth of a substantial portfolio of brands. With more than 30 licensed and owned brands, including some of the most sought-a

T:P2.3.text: G-III excels at bringing excitement and confidence to customers through the fashion we create. We are global experts in design, sourcing, distribution and marketing, which enables us to fuel the growth of a substantial portfolio of brands. With more than 30 licensed and owned brands, including some of the most sought-after names in global fashion, our success is driven by our team’s entrepreneurial spirit and our deep relationships across the industry.

T:P2.4.text: Bring excitement to fashion by unlocking the potential of our brands

T:P2.5.text: Platform for Success that powers our priorities:

T:P2.6.text: High-performing, forward-thinking team and experienced senior leadership

C:P1.1.text: Oxford | Premium American Lifestyle Brand Company

C:P1.2.text: Oxford is a house of brands specializing in premium to high-end American lifestyle and leisure.

C:P1.3.text: Lilly Pulitzer is an explosion of colorful prints and timeless silhouettes, taking women of all generations to a resort state of mind.

C:P1.4.text: Johnny Was is igniting women to embrace a bohemian California spirit—effortless, creative and soulful.

C:P1.5.text: Sharing the spirit of coastal living

C:P1.6.text: Known for its inspired use of colors drawn from the southern coast, Southern Tide connects the dream of boundless adventure with classic American prep style.

C:P1.7.text: Blending refined design with everyday comfort and enduring quality, The Beaufort Bonnet Company creates products meant to be worn often, loved deeply, and passed down through generations.

C:P1.8.text: Duck Head is a traditional men's apparel brand, producing pieces of enduring quality and timeless style.

C:P1.9.text: Every Step of a Well Loved Life

C:P1.10.text: Jack Rogers brings easy stylish sophistication to women of all ages sparking joy and punctuating her look at home and away.

C:P1.12.text: Tommy Bahama is a brand that takes you on a journey to paradise—blending resort wear with warm, tropical immersive hospitality.

C:P1.13.text: With more than 80 years of experience, Oxford has built a house of emotionally resonant lifestyle brands that can stand the test of time and trends.

C:P1.14.text: We find, grow, and elevate brands people return to— again and again— because they bring genuine happiness.”

C:P1.15.text: Tom Chubb CEO of Oxford Industries, Inc.

C:P1.16.text: Our approach is steady, focused and proven.

C:P1.17.text: We pair the creativity of independent lifestyle brands with the scale and structure of a seasoned partner. Together, we achieve disciplined growth and build legacies that turn passion into lasting value.

C:P1.18.text: By allowing lifestyle brands to remain independent while reinforcing operators with centralized support, we empower scaling and modernizing with integrity.

C:P2.1.text: About Oxford | House of Lifestyle Brands

C:P2.2.text: Oxford is a house of premium American lifestyle brands, stewarding distinctive companies with shared support and creative autonomy for long-term growth.

C:P2.4.text: We are the parent company behind the most beloved lifestyle brands in the U.S.

C:P2.5.text: Headquartered in Atlanta, GA, Oxford is not just an owner. We’re stewards, growing great businesses, while staying true to what makes them special.

C:P2.7.text: Growing from a WWII-era manufacturer into a leading brand steward, we have consistently evolved alongside the world, investing through headwinds, anticipating consumer shifts, and embracing change as a growth strategy.

C:P2.8.text: Founded as a manufacturer of private label apparel

C:P2.9.text: Expands further into womenswear, menswear, and childrenswear with Lilly Pulitzer, Southern Tide, Duck Head, and The Beaufort Bonnet Company

C:P2.10.text: Invests in retail expansion and scalable infrastructure with state-of-the-art distribution center

C:P2.11.text: Everyone at Oxford sees themselves as part of a family that learns from each other, rises together, and works toward collective success. We fill our teams with those deeply connected to our mission and committed to growth at all levels.

T:P2.10.text: Diversified distribution network to reach customers

C:P3.1.text: Our Brands | Premium American Lifestyle | Oxford

C:P3.6.text: Tommy Bahama is our largest brand, representing over half our business. Its powerful reach and consumer awareness are fueled by its universal appeal—effortlessly evoking the feeling of a tropical getaway.

C:P3.8.text: It all started with one incredible woman who had the courage to find her joy and create her own sunshine.

C:P3.11.text: Johnny Was pieces are known for their captivating details that inspire a sense of wanderlust. Each collection reflects the brand’s signature California spirit, first embodied in its original Santa Monica store.

C:P3.2.text: Discover Oxford’s house of premium lifestyle brands built on stewardship, creativity, and emotionally resonant experiences that endure over time.
